fishing: WHEN: Fri Nov 20 good solunar (63/100), winds N 3-10 mph gusts 19, mild ~72-74F, water 73-74F. PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, whiting, ladyfish, flounder, jacks, blue runners at Englewood Beach / Manasota / Blind Pass / Stump Pass; live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: baby gags and trout on grassy flats, Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish along ICW and Stump Pass; redfish under mangroves/oysters, snook, sheepshead on docks. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, sheepshead, Spanish when seas allow; deeper grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 13 (snook/redfish/trout active, Spanish/ladyfish/pompano, baby gags, lots of redfish under mangroves), FL Sportsman SW / Capt. Mike recent reports.
redtide: FWC Nov 20 update: K. brevis at very low concentrations in one Charlotte County sample in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NWFL (Bay and Gulf counties). No bloom near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation reported. Next update Nov 24.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key Beach GOOD (10 CFU/100mL Nov 16). Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota ~149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
